questions.question: What does the word 'dinosaur' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Deinos' means terrible and 'sauros' means lizard in Greek! 🦎

questions.question: Which was the largest meat-eating dinosaur?
questions.explanation: Spinosaurus was bigger than T-Rex at up to 18 metres long! 🦕

questions.question: What did Triceratops use its three horns for?
questions.explanation: Triceratops used its horns to defend against predators like T-Rex! 🦏

questions.question: Which dinosaur had the longest neck?
questions.explanation: Brachiosaurus had an incredibly long neck to reach tall treetops! 🦒

questions.question: How did dinosaurs reproduce?
questions.explanation: Dinosaurs laid eggs just like modern birds and reptiles! 🥚

questions.question: What are birds considered to be?
questions.explanation: Birds evolved from theropod dinosaurs — they're tiny living dinos! 🐦

questions.question: How long ago did dinosaurs go extinct?
questions.explanation: A huge asteroid hit Earth 66 million years ago and wiped them out! ☄️
